'''Eron''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Republic Army]] who fought in the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in [[3640 BBY]]. Assigned to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]]'s [[Shanra Immel's squad|squad]], the soldier served with [[Republic Special Forces Division]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] during a [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|battle]] on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalandis Seven]]. Amid the fighting Eron and the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] were ordered to destroy the [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|local spaceport]] and successfully completed their objective.

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">The finales of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in which the [[Battle of Corellia]] ends, take place in [[3640 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]]. As "[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]" is set after the battle as well as forty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the start of the [[Great Galactic War]], which ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' dates to [[3681 BBY]], the story must take place in 3640 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Eron served as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Army]]. The soldier was assigned to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel's squad]] and worked with [[Republic Special Forces Division|SpecForce]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] in a [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|battle]] on [[Kalandis Seven]], a desolate [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] covered in [[Water/Legends|fog]]. During the battle, Eron and the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] were tasked with the destruction of the local [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-controlled [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|spaceport]]. On the trek to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], the squad was attacked, and fellow squad member [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Amden vor Keioidian]] was [[Death/Legends|fatally]] wounded. [[Shanra Immel|Immel]] activated Keioidian's [[med tracer]] before making the decision to leave him behind, ordering the squad to move out.<ref name="TlBoCJM" />

Three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later, Eron, Immel, Malcom, and the rest of the squad reached their objective and went on to plant several [[targeting beacon]]s, which would allow Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to destroy the spaceport regardless of the fog. Eron and the squad succeeded in planting the beacons, and the spaceport was destroyed shortly after.<ref name="TlBoCJM" />

==Personality and traits==
Eron liked to collect antique [[Music/Legends|music]] recordings.<ref name="TlBoCJM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eron appeared, albeit voice only, in [[Alexander Freed]]'s short story "[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 137|137th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="TlBoCJM" /> on [[October 23]], [[2012]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/137|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #137}}</ref>
